changelog: Branches are gone. This is one shop, so there is now one Main Branch and no branch question anywhere — not on New Order, not on the user form, not on the roles screen, not on any report.
The Branches screen has been removed, along with the three branch permissions that kept appearing while setting up roles.
Everything that existed has been moved onto the Main Branch — orders, payments, customers and users — so no past record was lost.

Also fixed: the GST report and the Sales report grouped by item or category were both failing with a database error. An unquoted column alias had been broken for a while and nobody had opened those two screens.
